author: opt-N5

contract.sync_assumed: the whole hardware warp calls the primitive together (all logical warps at once), as the harness does
contract.sync_performed: shuffles, ballots and one any-vote over the full hardware warp, no barrier
contract.type_constraints: bf16 keys only, one row of N keys per call packed as bf16x2 words (the harness's packed_striped arrangement, items 2 (j LW + lane) and 2 (j LW + lane) + 1 in word j), the even items form set A in the low halves and the odd items set B in the high halves, one more bitonic merge on one-key words after the SIMD network, int32 source indices derived from the position. fp32 keys unsupported
contract.nan_behavior: a NaN key is never selected (it loses every max.bf16x2 and min.bf16x2 against a number and both set.gt and set.eq are false), so with fewer than k non-NaN keys output slots stay unwritten. Focus-set inputs carry no NaN. -0.0 equals +0.0: the network orders -0.0 below +0.0, the recovery classifies by IEEE comparison, the selected set is the oracle's set in every case (signed_zero pattern passes under both requirements). Denormals compared as values
contract.tie_break_support: both unsorted requirements with the same code: the tie class at the k-th key fills the remaining slots, in index order whenever it has to be capped (prefer_smaller_index exact by construction), measured identical throughput under both requirements in every cell
contract.sorted_output_support: none: the greater class is written in lane order, then the tie class (lane order on the common path, index order on the capped path). A sorted output would need one shuffle per selected key to move the recovered index to its network position
contract.k_range: [1, N / 2] with MaxK = round_up(k, LW) dividing N / 2, measured k 4, 16, 32, 64
contract.n_range: N = 2 x LW x words with (N / 2) / MaxK a power of two, N at least 64 at LW 32 (N 32 unsupported, each set would hold fewer keys than lanes), measured N 64 to 256

correctness_notes: Oracle battery (13 cases) passed on every cell under both requirements. Control W1x_vimnmx_eager in the same lock section, commit 30f5b8f821 (batch b2, ops_bf16 exchange, ballot-rank tie class in every call). Both requirements compile the same code and measured identical throughput to 0.1 percent. The fast-recovery form is card N5_split_f_b200_20261025_1.

low_level: Throughput kernel at N 128 k 32: 336 SASS instructions, the same count as the T42 one-word control, with 48 SHFL against 75 and 82 HMNMX2 against 153 VIMNMX, the rest is the recovery (4 HSET2, 4 VOTE, 6 POPC, the scan) and the predicate rebuilding (ISETP 51 against 5). Registers 28 to 40 at N 64 to 128 (occupancy 8 to 6), 40 to 48 at N 256 (6 to 5).
algorithmic: Same-session throughput against the T42 one-word network (b2): N 64 320 against 328 to 331 (0.97x to 0.98x), N 128 k 4 to 32 370 against 356 to 358 (1.03x to 1.04x), N 128 k 64 354 against 302 (1.17x), N 256 k 4 to 32 427 against 363 to 367 (1.16x to 1.18x), N 256 k 64 384 against 248 (1.54x). Latency 1003 against 695 at N 64 (0.69x), 1145 against 1017 at N 128 (0.89x), 1570 against 1718 at N 256 k at most 32 (1.09x faster), 1652 against 1322 at N 256 k 64 (0.80x).

The first batch's select-form exchange measured 318, 385, 346, 421, 377 at N 64, N 128 k 32, N 128 k 64, N 256 k 32, N 256 k 64 (control 328 to 367): the ternary form lost 4 percent at N 128 here while it gained 3 percent on the two-row kernel in the same session, a T28 schedule effect at a kernel whose instruction count equals the control's.
negative: At N 128 k 32 the split form ties the one-word control in instruction count (336) and nearly in throughput (1.03x): half the shuffles are not worth more than the final merge and the recovery at this N.
surprises: The ternary exchange form, 16 instructions fewer than the select form in this kernel, measured 4 percent slower at N 128 (370 against 385) in consecutive sections against the same control, the reverse of the two-row kernel in the same session.
open_questions: Whether the schedule swing between the two exchange forms at N 128 (plus 3 percent on two rows, minus 4 percent on the split) has a structural cause or is the T28 fragility, not resolved.
